`final class CircleShader`<br/>
**Extends:** [`ShaderProgram`](/reference/shaders/shaderprogram/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.shader.impl` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [CircleShader.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/shader/impl/CircleShader.java)

The shader of discs, which masks what is drawn outside a circle with a smooth edge.

## Description

[`DrawShape.drawCircle`](/reference/drawing/drawshape/#DrawShape-method-drawCircle) and [`CircleShaderPass`](/reference/shaders/circleshaderpass/) use it.
